title: DTC requirements profile
description: A versioned, machine-readable list of requirement rows. Every row carries a status (published | inferred | unknown), sources, a date and a confidence. Code reads rows; it never hard-codes a requirement (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md principle 3). Gate G-DTCC: only rows with status 'published' and a primary source may be treated as DTCC fact. Output that uses inferred or unknown rows must label them.

profileId.description: Stable profile name, e.g. dtc-generic, dtc-stellar.

version.description: Date-based version, YYYY-MM-DD with optional .N revision. Bump on any row change.

disclaimer.description: Must be echoed by every tool output. Fixed wording: 'DTC-shaped, not DTC-certified.' plus any profile-specific caveat.

extends.description: profileId of a parent. Child rows replace parent rows with the same id; other parent rows are inherited unchanged.

supersedes.description: profileId@version this file replaces, if any.

sourceTag.description: P primary, S secondary, V vendor, I inference, E estimate, U unverified (docs/SOURCES.md).

retrievedAt.description: Date a human or agent read the source for this row.

via.description: How we know: 'discovery-note:<file>#<section>' when copied from a note, 'scaffold-reread' when re-read at scaffold time.

locator.description: Section, condition number or page label inside the source.

id.description: Dotted path: <area>.<slug>[.<slug>], lower case. Stable forever; scenarios reference it.

statement.description: One-sentence human-readable requirement or open question.

value.description: Machine-readable value the code reads. null when status is unknown.

basis.description: Required for inferred rows: why we think this, and why it is not published.

candidates.description: For unknown/inferred rows: the options still open. Scenarios must not assume one.

noteRef.description: Pointer into the discovery notes, e.g. dtc_participant_package_and_requirements.md#2.3-W1.

unblockedBy.description: For unknown rows: what event or document would let us fill it in (e.g. a DTCC Stellar wallet-provider guide).
